tasks.short: Prepare industrial product sketches, drawings and blueprints.

steps.what: Sketch product ideas and choose actual geometry, materials and design intent
inputs: actual product brief and designer research

steps.what: Generate linked product drawing views and dimension sheets from chosen CAD geometry
inputs: designer-created sketches and chosen geometry
outputs: native linked drawing sheets for checking

steps.what: Refine and approve complete final drawing sheets, dimensions and tolerances
inputs: native linked drawing sheets for checking
designer-created sketches and chosen geometry

steps.what: Commit the approved final product drawing version
inputs: approved final product drawing version

tasks.design: Configure native linked views and sheet templates in {CAD}. The designer creates ideas and actual geometry, then checks generated projections and dimensions. Final tolerances and design intent remain human. Approve the complete final drawing version before its separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated projection and drawing-sheet preparation from already chosen geometry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native associative drawing views and reusable sheets.
tasks.still_hard: Original form, usable geometry and production-suitable tolerances.
tasks.human_edge: Reconciling appearance with product use and manufacturability.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive drafting around designer-created product form.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAD systems can create associative views and drawing sheets from actual geometry; existing use must be checked.

assumptions: Shares and reductions are provisional. Only residual manual view preparation changes; existing CAD rendering and template runtime earn no saving.

s1 includes full actual geometry creation and supplies part_id, revision and chosen dimensions. s2 retains 17.5 hours checking projection, dimensions and stale links; non-CAD artwork and unmatched views stay manual.

Final refinement and tolerances retain full effort. Approval follows the complete final drawing; changes void it. Same-system commit remains full effort, with share 1 reflecting schema granularity rather than measured click cost.
research_questions: Which drawing views are still redrafted after current CAD features?

incremental.description: Maintain drawing templates and projection checks

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final product drawing version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 35 times 50% = 17.5 less 1 upkeep = 16.5. Low halves view-preparation benefit: 8.75 less 1 = 7.75; provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Refine designs using working models and actual production constraints.

steps.what: Check customer changes, production limitations and actual working model findings
inputs: actual customer specifications, production constraints and working model observations

steps.what: Propagate designer-selected dimension changes through native linked CAD parts and views
inputs: designer-checked change requirements
actual designer-selected dimensional revisions
outputs: checked linked revised geometry and views

steps.what: Modify and test actual working models to refine function and appearance
inputs: checked linked revised geometry and views
actual working models and production limitations
outputs: actual model tests and designer refinements

steps.what: Record actual model findings and approve complete final refined design version
inputs: actual model tests and designer refinements
outputs: approved final refined design and actual model findings

steps.what: Commit approved final refined design and actual model findings
inputs: approved final refined design and actual model findings

tasks.design: Configure native parameter dependencies in {CAD} so designer-selected revisions propagate across linked parts and drawing views. Physical working-model modification and tests remain full work, followed by actual findings capture and final design approval before commit. This does not infer production feasibility from a regenerated model.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same selected dimensional change may be redrawn in several linked views.
tasks.still_hard: Actual product handling, production constraints and design refinement.
tasks.human_edge: Feeling when a working model fails the intended use.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated geometric propagation around actual model refinement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: parametric CAD propagates selected changes across linked parts and views; the proposed dependency coverage requires checking.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; count only residual redraw after current CAD configuration. Existing regeneration runtime earns no saving.

The designer chooses actual dimensions and revision intent within fully retained s1 and s2 checks. Native part_id, revision, parameter and dependency links supply propagation inputs; s2 retains 15 hours for exceptions and manual corrections.

Working-model work, actual test capture and final design choices retain full effort. Complete final design precedes approval and separate commit, which earns no saving. Changed designs require renewed approval.
research_questions: Which chosen revisions still require repeated view changes?

incremental.description: Maintain parameter dependencies and revision checks

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final refined design and actual model findings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 25 times 40% = 10 less 1 upkeep = 9. Low halves propagation benefit: 5 less 1 = 4; provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture actual supplier costs, product materials and manufacturing assumptions for the design
inputs: actual selected design, supplier quotes and production method evidence

steps.what: Assemble design material quantities and quoted-cost comparisons using native BOM exports
inputs: designer-verified feasibility inputs
actual CAD bill of materials

steps.what: Evaluate appearance, safety, function, serviceability, production methods and market feasibility
inputs: checked quantities and cost comparison
actual product requirements and manufacturing evidence

steps.what: Write and approve complete final product feasibility assessment
inputs: designer feasibility judgments and limitations

steps.what: Save approved final product feasibility assessment
inputs: approved final product feasibility assessment

tasks.design: Configure native {CAD} bill-of-material exports and a linked cost-comparison sheet. Actual supplier quote capture and all feasibility judgment remain full work. The complete final assessment precedes approval and its separate save. Cost arithmetic is evidence for the designer, never proof of safety or market success.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated transcription of design quantities into cost comparisons.
tasks.enabler_now: Native BOM export and exact part-reference spreadsheet links.
tasks.still_hard: Safety, serviceability and realistic production and market feasibility.
tasks.human_edge: Recognizing when attractive cost figures hide an unusable product.
tasks.altitude: Less quantity transcription before unchanged feasibility judgment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAD bill-of-material exports can feed quantity and quoted-cost comparisons; this industrial product use is proposed.

assumptions: All allocations are provisional; confirm residual quantity copying after native tools. Existing calculations and export runtime earn no saving.

s1 counts actual quote and production evidence capture. CAD supplies part_id, revision, quantity and unit; quotes supply actual price, currency, date and scope. s2 retains 18 hours checking revisions, exclusions and units; missing matches remain manual.
Safety, market, function and manufacturing judgments and final writing stay full effort. Approval follows final assessment; changes void approval. Same-system save earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which quantity and quote links remain manually recopied?

incremental.description: Maintain part-to-quote mappings and unit checks

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final product feasibility assessment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 30 times 40% = 12 less 1 upkeep = 11. Low halves quantity-preparation benefit: 6 less 1 = 5; provisional.

tasks.short: Confer with departments and customers about manufactured product design concepts.

steps.what: Assemble current product concept versions and actual department comments in a native review view
inputs: actual concept versions and existing engineering, marketing, production or customer comments

steps.what: Confer with engineering, marketing, production, sales or customers and evaluate product concepts
inputs: checked design discussion context
actual participant concerns and design constraints
outputs: actual concept discussion findings and unresolved choices

steps.what: Write and approve actual concept discussion record and exact follow-up recipients
inputs: actual concept discussion findings and unresolved choices
outputs: approved final actual discussion record and exact follow-up recipients

steps.what: Save approved actual concept discussion record
inputs: approved final actual discussion record and exact follow-up recipients

steps.what: Send approved actual design discussion follow-up to approved participants
inputs: approved final actual discussion record and exact follow-up recipients

tasks.design: Configure native concept-version and existing-comment views in {DESIGN_REVIEW}. Actual discussion and actual follow-up writing remain full work. The complete final record and recipient list exist before separate save and send approvals. External send authority covers the customer branch; all-internal delivery uses internal authority in deployment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly finding current concept versions and prior department comments.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling actual engineering, customer and commercial concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Identifying the compromise that preserves the intended product use.
tasks.altitude: Less review-context assembly before human design discussion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: design review tools can link versioned concepts and existing comments; actual deployment must be checked.

assumptions: Shares and reductions are provisional, conditional on residual context retrieval after current tools. Existing review routing earns no saving.

Actual designers and department commenters already produce concept_id, revision, comment_id and author; s1 retains 7.5 hours for freshness and relevance checks. Missing comments are obtained manually during retained discussion.

No transcript or agreed decision appears free: s2 and s3 retain actual listening and capture in full. The final record and exact recipients precede approval; changes void approval. Save and send remain full effort.
research_questions: Which actual concept and comment retrieval remains manual?

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final actual concept discussion record
s3 complete final actual discussion follow-up and exact recipients
